All right, title and interest in and to the Results and Proceeds and to the Advertising Materials (as defined below) shall be and remain the absolute property of TDA forever
findings.explanation: This clause transfers ownership of your work to the client immediately without making it conditional on you receiving full payment.
findings.suggested_change: All right, title and interest in and to the Results and Proceeds and to the Advertising Materials shall remain with the Contractor until the Contractor has been paid in full.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to suggest one small modification before I sign: - The relevant clause currently transfers ownership of the work immediately without making it conditional on receiving full payment, and I propose updating it so that ownership remains with the contractor until full payment is received. Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable. Best regards,
